verdicts.title: Proof Complexity Lower Bounds from Algebraic Circuit Complexity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We give upper and lower bounds on the power of subsystems of the Ideal Proof System (IPS), the algebraic proof system recently proposed by Grochow and Pitassi, where the circuits comprising the proof come from various restricted algebraic circuit classes.
